entities.summary: Dalton Prout is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman, who spent the majority of his playing career with the Columbus Blue Jackets of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected 154th overall in the 2010 NHL Entry Draft by the Blue Jackets. He is currently a scout for the Florida Panthers.
